note: Central bank policy decision days read off each bank's OWN schedule page, for the event families' calendar backfill (timing only: no decision, no surprise). Dates are facts copied from the page named in `source` on `read`; a year a bank does not list is UNMEASURED and reported, never a year with no meetings. `at`/`tz` is the announcement time: `time_basis` says whether the page stated it or it is an unverified convention. Add a year by reading the bank's page and appending dates here, never in code. `window_h` is the +/- hours a reader must widen around the stamp (0 when the bank states the time). `transcribed: true` means the dates were copied by a reading agent, not parsed from the page by code; it stays true until a run re-reads the page and matches.

banks.title: BoJ Policy Statement
banks.time_basis: unverified convention 12:00 Asia/Tokyo; the BoJ publishes the statement when the meeting ends, which varies by meeting, so a reader must widen its window
banks.covered: 2015-01 to 2015-09 and 2016 to 2027; 2015-10 to 2015-12 and earlier years were cut off in the read and are UNMEASURED

banks.title: BoE Bank Rate decision
banks.time_basis: stated: 'The Monetary Policy summary and minutes are published at 12 noon on a Thursday eight times a year.' (bankofengland.co.uk monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes page)
banks.covered: 2026 and 2027 only; the page lists no earlier years and the archive list loads by script, so 2025 and earlier are UNMEASURED

unmeasured.why: the ECB decisions page read 2026-11-10 is a landing page with no dates, and the meeting calendar was read only as a model summary (not verbatim); nothing is written until a verbatim read exists
